data.title: Ventas Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.52 Per Common Share
data.description: Chicago-based Ventas, Inc. (NYSE: VTR) has recently approved a quarterly dividend of $0.52 per common share. This dividend is set to be disbursed on October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record by the end of business on September 30, 2026. Ventas, Inc. is a prominent player in the industry, with about 1,450 properties across North America, catering to the needs of a rapidly expanding aging demographic. This move underlines the company's commitment to providing exceptional environments for this growing population segment.

data.title: dLocal Partners with Oscilar to Further Optimize AML and Compliance for the Next Era of Cross-Border Payments
data.description: A Cross-border payment platform based in Palo Alto, California, has partnered with Oscilar to utilize their AI-powered solutions for anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and compliance. This partnership will cover over 60 markets worldwide.

data.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Falls, Cyber Plays Soar Amid AI Fears; These Stocks Near Entries (Live Coverage)
data.description: Today, the Dow Jones index experienced a decline on the stock market, coinciding with a significant increase in oil prices. President Trump expressed criticism towards calls for a slowdown in artificial intelligence (AI) development. Cybersecurity companies stood out as strong performers. The stock market today was marked by the Dow falling and cyber plays seeing a surge amidst concerns surrounding AI. Certain stocks were noted to be nearing entry points.

data.title: CoStar Group Names Felix Kusch President of Homes.com
data.description: A prominent online real estate marketplace provider, CoStar Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSGP), announced the appointment of Felix Kusch as the President of Homes.com. Kusch brings valuable experience from overseeing Europe's top real estate portals as the CEO of Immoweb in Belgium and Immowelt in Germany. Prior to this, he spearheaded M&A initiatives at Axel Springer Digital. With Kusch at the helm, Homes.com is set to benefit from his expertise and leadership in the property market sector.

data.title: Advanced Drainage Systems Releases 2026 Sustainability Report
data.description: In Hilliard, Ohio, Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. (NYSE: WMS), a key player in stormwater and onsite wastewater solutions, unveiled its Fiscal 2026 Sustainability Report. The report highlights the company's dedication to responsible practices and environmental care. Scott Barbour, the spokesperson, emphasized the importance of sustainability in risk management, operational enhancement, and value creation. This report showcases ADS's ongoing efforts towards sustainability, showcasing their commitment to eco-friendly operations.

data.title: Robin van Poelje to Retire as CEO of Topicus.com Inc. on October 1, 2026; Board Names Ramon Zanders as his Successor
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Topicus.com Inc. shared news that Robin van Poelje is retiring from his role as Chief Executive Officer due to personal reasons. Ramon Zanders, who currently serves as the Group CEO of Total Specific Solutions Blue operating group under Topicus, will take over as the new Chief Executive Officer as decided by the Topicus Board of Directors. This transition will take effect on October 1, 2026. Post his resignation as CEO, Mr. van Poelje will maintain his position on the Board of Directors at Topicus.

data.title: LPA to Present at Water Tower Research Virtual Insights Conference
data.description: Logistic Properties of the Americas (NYSE American: LPA) disclosed that their executive management team will partake in the Water Tower Research Virtual Insights Conference on September 22-23, 2026. CEO Esteban Saldarriaga and CFO Paul Smith will represent LPA at this event. This announcement was made from San José, Costa Rica.

data.title: DLH Appoints Brooke Pierce President of Health Business Group
data.description: On September 14, 2026, DLH Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: DLHC) disclosed the appointment of Brooke Pierce as President of Health. DLH, a prominent supplier of digital, engineering, and scientific services for health and defense missions, announced the news. Pierce assumed the role on the same day of the announcement.

data.title: Adigreen Launches to Help Defence, Security and Dual-Use Technology Companies Expand Across African Markets
data.description: A commercial growth firm named Adigreen has officially launched in London, targeting the African defense, security, and dual-use technology sectors. The company aims to assist international technology firms in expanding and securing contracts in specific African markets. This launch aligns with a trend of defense, security, and technology companies shifting focus towards Africa to capitalize on the increasing demand for secure communication, cybersecurity, surveillance, and autonomous systems. Adigreen's services cater to companies looking for sustained growth in these sectors across Africa.

data.title: Sysco Announces Common Stock Offering
data.description: On September 14, 2026, food distribution company Sysco Corporation (NYSE:SYY) revealed plans to launch an offering of $1.0 billion worth of its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "SYY." The company, also known as Sysco, aims to issue these shares as part of the announced Offering, marking a significant financial move for the corporation.

data.title: Janus Living Declares Monthly Common Stock Cash Dividends for the Fourth Quarter of 2026
data.description: In Denver, Janus Living, Inc. (NYSE: JAN), a senior housing REIT, declared a monthly common stock dividend of $0.0475 per share on September 11, 2026. The dividend is for the fourth quarter of 2026 and will be payable to stockholders of record as of the close of business on specified dates. The announcement indicates a consistent distribution to shareholders.

data.title: Ocean Power Technologies Announces First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results
data.description: During the quarter, the company excelled in operational performance and advanced its presence in the defense market, while also progressing in the establishment of persistent autonomous maritime infrastructure.
